lede: USC carries the stronger underlying team rating — +9.2 against +0.8, a 8.3-point separation on a neutral field before home advantage, travel or rest.
EdgeDesk makes it Rutgers +12.7 before any sportsbook number is consulted, with USC winning 80% of simulations.
The position-group comparison shows where the separation comes from: the widest measured gap is scheme fit, where USC leads Rutgers by 61 places nationally.
Data confidence on this matchup is 72% — high by this board’s standards, so the margin is the strongest part of the read.
